Package com.stzteam.mars.diagnostics

Class AlertRegistry

java.lang.Object
com.stzteam.mars.diagnostics.AlertRegistry
public class AlertRegistry extends Object
A centralized registry of the most recently reported ActionStatus for every MARS subsystem. Gives dashboards, the GCS app, or a pre-match checklist a single place to query "what's currently wrong on the robot" instead of polling each subsystem individually.

Can be globally disabled via setEnabled(boolean) to skip the bookkeeping entirely (e.g. for competition, if the extra map write per subsystem per loop matters).

    • setEnabled

      public static void setEnabled(boolean value)
      Globally enables or disables the registry. When disabled, report(java.lang.String, com.stzteam.mars.diagnostics.ActionStatus) becomes a no-op and existing entries are left untouched (not cleared).
      Parameters:
      value - true to enable reporting, false to disable it.

    • isEnabled

      public static boolean isEnabled()

    • report

      public void report(String subsystemName, ActionStatus status)
      Reports the latest status for a given subsystem. Intended to be called once per loop from ModularSubsystem. No-op if the registry is disabled or the status is null.
      Parameters:
      subsystemName - The reporting subsystem's name.
      status - Its latest evaluated status.

    • getActiveAlerts

      public List<AlertRegistry.SubsystemAlert> getActiveAlerts()
      Returns every currently registered status that is NOT nominal (i.e. anything with severity above StatusColorCode.Severity.OK). This is what a dashboard or pre-match checklist should display.
      Returns:
      A list of active (non-nominal) alerts across all reporting subsystems.

    • hasCriticalAlerts

      public boolean hasCriticalAlerts()
      Returns true if any subsystem currently has a CRITICAL status. Useful as a quick gate before enabling for a match.

    • getAllStatuses

      public Map<String,ActionStatus> getAllStatuses()
      Returns the full raw map of subsystem name -> latest status, including nominal ones.

    • clear

      public void clear()
      Clears all registered statuses. Useful when resetting between test sessions.
